result.title: FOCUS: A Lightweight Mamba-2 Model for EEG-Based Cognitive Workload Classification
result.summary: Cognitive workload estimation from physiological signals is increasingly relevant in high-risk environments, where continuous and unobtrusive monitoring can inform adaptive systems and safety interventions. This paper presents FOCUS (Frequency-band Optimized Cognitive-load Ultralight SSM), a compact Mamba-2-based model for EEG-based binary workload classification under constrained data conditions. Rather than learning frequency sensitivity from data, FOCUS encodes preprocessed multi-channel EEG using a fixed FFT decomposition that covers the five canonical EEG bands. The proposed model combines depthwise-separable convolution and a weight-shared encoder-bottleneck Mamba-2 pair, with 0.04 million parameters and 0.11 GFLOPs. Evaluated in a pilot study with 11 participants under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation across three cognitively distinct tasks, FOCUS achieves 74.75% accuracy on the full dataset at 0.08 ms GPU model-forward latency. In the weight-sharing ablation, the shared configuration achieves 4.55 percentage points higher accuracy on the full dataset than the non-shared variant while reducing the SSM parameter budget; however, this difference does not reach statistical significance under a two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test ($p=0.083$). Overall, the selected FOCUS configuration provides a favorable trade-off between classification performance and computational cost within this controlled pilot setting.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FOCUS：用固定 FFT 五频带分解编码多通道 EEG，经深度可分离卷积与权重共享的 encoder–bottleneck Mamba-2 对组成 0.04M 参数模型，做二分类认知负荷识别；11 人 LOSO 试点达 74.75% 准确率，并消融权重共享（+4.55 点但不显著）。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接联系；但其共享参数的 SSM 对偶结构与固定频带预分解，可能为循环式 latent 状态更新和任务必要信息的预筛提供参照，可供核查。
